description: Reference figures for assessing organisational readiness for change and for calibrating adoption-risk assumptions in a roadmap or business case. Use as priors, not as forecasts — replace with client data as soon as it is measured.

items.name: Sponsor visibility
items.description: Active, visible executive sponsorship is the single strongest predictor of change success.
indicators: Sponsor attends steering committee in person
Sponsor communicates directly to affected staff at least monthly
Sponsor removes at least one escalated barrier per quarter
items.response: Where sponsorship is passive, treat adoption as HIGH risk and add a sponsor-coaching workstream.

items.name: Middle-management alignment
items.description: Line managers translate change into daily priorities; their resistance is the most common cause of stalled adoption.
indicators: Managers can restate the case for change
Managers cascade communications within one week
items.response: Add manager-specific ADKAR interventions before staff training.

items.name: Change saturation
items.description: Number of concurrent change initiatives hitting the same population.
indicators: More than three concurrent initiatives per team
Recent failed or reversed initiative in the same area
items.response: Sequence the roadmap to limit concurrent change per population; make saturation explicit in the risk register.
